name: qa_files_c
title: OS-FILES-C C2c: the File screen's EXPORT page, OG PROJECT row on the card: the row, the question, the overlay and the strip, a whole export of t-v16 with its cost (T16: step max, cpu underruns and over-budget 0), and a cancel; writes Export/<project> OG folders, never replaces a file

steps.note: (a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is BACK on the Navigator, the keyboard (cancel, never accept: F1 accepts) and the choosers, OS-UXF-KEYS item 5)
(the File screen keeps its page when it is left: F6 twice ends on PROJECTS from EXPORT or PROJECTS, so that the F7 below is EXPORT, not PROJECTS back)
SONG, PATTERN, SONG STEMS, PATT STEMS, OG PROJECT: the fifth row (four Downs end on it whatever row the page had: it stops at the last)

steps.say: OS-FILES-C C2c, rows QA-FIL-082..089 of docs/qa/catalogue/file.md (docs/specs/OS-FILES-C.md section 8, T10 and T16): the EXPORT page's OG PROJECT row. It WRITES on the card in the unit: new folders Export/<project> OG, Export/<project> OG 2 ..; it never replaces or removes a file. The project is t-v16 (16 samples, about 7.6 MB: the maintainer's, on the card). No official unit has opened an export yet: the row says EXPERIMENTAL

steps.note: (a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is BACK on the Navigator, the keyboard (cancel, never accept: F1 accepts) and the choosers, OS-UXF-KEYS item 5)
(the File screen keeps its page when it is left: F6 twice ends on PROJECTS from EXPORT or PROJECTS, so that the F7 below is EXPORT, not PROJECTS back)
SONG, PATTERN, SONG STEMS, PATT STEMS, OG PROJECT: the fifth row (four Downs end on it whatever row the page had: it stops at the last)

QA-FIL-082: the key row is the page's (the compare is soft: on v0.6.8 91% of the key row's pixels differed from the golden although the labels read the same, so look at the shot; the card and the loss lines are the unit's: a folder name, MB, files, what is left out)

steps.say: QA-FIL-082: read the shot: FILE Export/<project> OG, SIZE about n MB, n FILES, EXPERIMENTAL on the row, the LOSES lines (t-v16 may lose none: then it says KEEPS everything the OG format has a place for)

steps.note: (T16: the cpu counters count from here)
the last export of this boot, if any (IDLE before the first)
F1: with something left out the strip asks first (LOSES ..: F1 AGAIN), else the export starts at once
the unit has the card write layer
the second F1 (only when the question was asked: a project that loses nothing has started already)
the modal progress overlay: the transport was stopped first
the overlay: FILE n OF m, the bar moves by files

steps.say: T16: the strip stays alive while it runs: the CPU chip and the clock move, a key does nothing but F8

steps.note: QA-FIL-084 (a project with nothing left out writes exactly the set of section 6) or QA-FIL-083 (it asked first): DONE n/n files
the overlay is gone when the set has ended
T16: the longest single step of any file's job and the steps that overran their slice: RECORD the figures (the cost table of docs/architecture/cpu-budget.md)

T16: where the time went: the worst step and its stage, then one line a stage (survey, plan, convert, write, sync, rename, dir, verify, other): max us, count, sum ms. RECORD them: the stage with the 263-360 ms is the one to bound
T16: no missed audio block while the export ran
T16: the render governor's over-budget count stays 0 (the export is main-loop work, never the render's)

steps.say: T16 by hand: MIDI-in jitter during the export (midi_clock_tool.py, a 120 BPM clock in on the DIN: the interval's spread against the same run with no export), and the JOB stats of a project with a 22,050 Hz and an 8,287 Hz sample (add them to t-v16 first, then rerun this scenario). Record the figures in docs/STATUS.md; they decide whether the survey needs slicing

QA-FIL-083: a project that loses something asks first: the strip says LOSES <n kinds>: F1 AGAIN, another key, a move, leaving the screen or 4 s takes it back; the second F1 counts again. Try it on a project with a module instrument or a 12 BIT instrument (by hand)

QA-FIL-114 (OS-LFOSINE): an instrument with an LFO of shape Sine in slots 1-48: OG PROJECT, F1: the strip and the page say `1 SINE LFO` (SINE LFO SHAPES WRITTEN AS TRIANGLE); after the export the file holds shape Triangle for that LFO (`load Export/<name> OG`, then the MOD page reads Triangle) and the project in the unit still says Sine (by hand)

QA-FIL-085 and 086 by ear and `inst n`: `load Export/<name> OG`, then `diag inst n` of a resampled sample and of an Amiga one: pitch and gain against the native project (T8 on the unit); a wavetable instrument is untouched; a project of the 1.1.14 law keeps its gain
QA-FIL-088: `diag load Export/<name> OG` loads the folder just made (the name is in `diag ogexp status`)
QA-FIL-089 (hardware, official unit): copy the folder into Projects/ of a card for an official 1.9.x unit and open it there: T9. Until the maintainer has done it the row stays EXPERIMENTAL

QA-FIL-087: a second export, F8 once it is running: the set stops after the file in hand, the strip says OG EXPORT CANCELLED: n OF m FILES, the folder has no project.mt (look at the card from a computer)
